answer: Escrow the payment until grading closes. Bind the sponsor's cut to the recruit, so when the recruit is caught duplicating, the sponsor's share is burned instead of refunded. Measure the cheapest attack, which is one funded identity submitting through the normal path; it costs a bond plus the grading latency and earns the same as honest work. Anything cheaper than that is either already blocked or a bug worth reporting. The atlas of known tricks gets longer every epoch, and the plume of easy clones keeps shrinking against that horizon.
